## PS5Save+ v0.1.0-alpha.2

First public-branch update after successful PS5 console validation of the unified payload, web dashboard and integrated launcher.

### Changed
- **Backup completion is immediate:** the completion toast is sent as soon as the operation finishes, without a progress-update timer. It replaces the last progress percentage when possible instead of waiting for that toast to disappear.
- Progress percentages retain the adaptive 10–30-second cadence; errors and warnings use a separate notification group and are not replaced.
- The main project README now reflects the tested single-ELF workflow.

### Included
Automatic PS4/PS5 save and trophy backups, daily snapshots, browsable backups and snapshots, a built-in dashboard on port **8755**, PS5-confirmed settings editing, localised notifications and a home-screen launcher installed when missing.

### Install
Download `ps5saveplus_v0.1.0-alpha.2.elf` and launch it with your PS5 payload loader. Use an exFAT USB drive for backups. Existing data and configuration remain under `/mnt/usb0/ps5save-plus/`.

The title shortcut opens `http://127.0.0.1:8755/` while the payload is running; the shortcut itself does not autostart the daemon after a reboot.

**Alpha:** core functionality has been verified on PS5 firmware 11.60. The new terminal-toast replacement policy is validated by host tests and requires final visual confirmation in the console notification overlay. Keep a separate copy of important saves.

Source: [jolissipo/PS5Save](https://github.com/jolissipo/PS5Save) · [GPL-3.0](https://github.com/jolissipo/PS5Save/blob/main/LICENSE)
